name: Al Haadi
description: Allah guides His creatures and shows the way to truth.
summary: The name Al Haadi emphasizes Allah's role as the ultimate guide and leader for humanity towards the right path. It signifies His ability to provide direction, wisdom, and understanding, helping individuals make righteous choices in their lives. The concept is rooted in the Quran and reflects the belief that guidance is a divine gift bestowed upon those who seek it sincerely.
